queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: One or more topics, brands, tickers, or people to search Google News for. Each runs as its own feed (up to ~100 articles).

language.title: Language
language.description: Google News language code, e.g. en-US, en-GB, es-ES, fr-FR, de-DE.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two letter country code, e.g. US, GB, CA, AU, IN, DE.

when.title: Recency window
when.description: Optional. Only return articles from the last N hours or days, e.g. 1h, 12h, 1d, 7d. Leave empty for the default feed.

maxPerQuery.title: Max articles per query
maxPerQuery.description: Cap on articles returned per search term (Google News serves up to about 100).

maxArticles.title: Max articles total
maxArticles.description: Maximum number of article rows to return across all queries. First 25 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The RSS feeds are a tolerant public source, so proxy is off by default. Supply one only if you run very large pulls and hit rate limits.
